name: Logging
description: Windows MDM settings in the Logging category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: AD Computer Group Process
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Enables logging of the AD Computer Group Processing.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\AdsComputerGroup
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: Driver Interface
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Enables logging of the driver interface.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\DriverInterface
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Select how FSLogix should enable logging. All logs is the default setting.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\LoggingEnabled
Values: 0 = No Logs, 1 = Specific Logs, 2 = All Logs

properties.name: Log Directory
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the location where log files should be stored. Local and UNC paths are accepted. Default is %ProgramData%\FSLogix\Logs

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\LogDir
Type: REG_SZ

properties.name: Log Keeping Period
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies how many days worth of log files to keep before being cleaned up.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\LogFileKeepingPeriod
Type: DWORD
Values: Min = 0, Max = 180
